questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:** 

I. Some X are M.

II. All W are X.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some M are not W.

II. No W is M.

III. Some M are not X.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d491f61a1844c11783d543d5e4ff5b9eb29d0b8e2f73f516ff44c74f8c9d6469.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some M are not W → Does not follow (As some X are M, all W are X. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. No W is M → Does not follow (As all W are X, some X are M. So,it is possible but not definitely true)

III. Some M are not X → Does not follow (As some X are M. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, None of the conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"None of the conclusions follow**".

P1 and P4 sit at the ends. A3 and P2 are facing each other. A4 is second to the left of A3. P4 is facing A1. A1 and A4 are at the ends.

Which of the following statements is correct?

I. A4 is facing P1.

II. P4 is second to the left of that male who is facing A2.
questions.solution:
**Given :**

 
• **Four males - P1, P2, P3 and P4 are sitting in a row facing towards the north (not necessarily in the same order)**
 
• **Four females - A1, A2, A3 and A4 are sitting in a row facing towards the face of these males (not necessarily in the same order). **

**​Explanation :**

1) A4 is second to the left of A3.

2) A1 and A4 are at the ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c32a5c61f96d3cde1b97f74691da712a3cc69a42793e87fc8ad1f3740b67bf63.png] 

3) P4 is facing A1.

4) P1 and P4 sit at the ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30ddc0c0b47a3bb953681142a01199fd976c7dab1482c0fa46eb2d99eefc313a.png] 

5) A3 and P2 are facing each other.

After positioning P2 only one female and one male position are left which will be occupied by A2 and P3 respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e3e581cd93a56b9dc22b234cb0cba7bb22419d7263db63338c9cf55fbb24ad9.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement :

I. A4 is facing P1 - This is correct.

II. P4 is second to the left of that male who is facing A2 - This is correct.

Here, Both I and II statements are correct.

Hence, **"****Both I and II"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Seven athletes A, B, C, D, E, F and G participate in a race. E is ahead of A but behind F. D is ahead of only two athlete. G is running last. C is running behind only two athlete. F is not the first.

Which athlete is running in the fourth position from behind?
questions.solution:
**Given : Seven athletes A, B, C, D, E, F and G participate in a race.**

**Explanation :**

1) E is ahead of A but behind F.

F > E > A 

2) C is running behind only two athlete.

3) G is running last.

_ > _ > C > _>_> _>G

4) D is ahead of only two athlete.

_> _ > C > _> D >_> G

5) F is not the first. So, From 1 we get,

_ > F > C > E > D > A > G

Only B is left, So the final arrangement is

**B > F > C **> E >** D > A > G**

Thus, according to the final arrangement E is running in the fourth position from behind.

Hence, **"E"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two numbers, what will be the value of the given expression?

20 and 10

10 + 30 - 5 × 20 ÷ 2
questions.solution:
**Given :**

**10 + 30 - 5 × 20 ÷ 2**

According to the question, by interchanging the given two numbers i.e 20 and 10 :

So according to the BODMAS rule ;

⇒ 20+ 30 - 5 × __**10 ÷ 2**__

⇒ 20 + 30 - __**5 × 5**__

⇒ __**20 + 30**__ - 25

⇒ __**50 - 25**__

⇒ **25**

Hence, "25" is the correct answer.
